name: isGeoRedundant
definition: Backup data is copied to storage in a geographically separate region.
population: the backup storage the integration lists, with its replication and region settings
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A listing that shows a copy of the backup data held in a region other than the primary.
citations: Backblaze B2 native API reference, b2_list_buckets: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-buckets

changeLog.change: Registered with the Backblaze B2 transforms. Other backup integrations already emit this key; their meaning is not yet validated against this entry.

notes: Backblaze B2: never True from the source account's read alone; all buckets in an account share one region and a destination in another account's region is not visible. No outbound replication is False.
